questions.question: The Border-Gavaskar trophy is played between ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India and Australia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Border-Gavaskar Trophy** is a Test cricket series played between **India and Australia**.
 
• The trophy is named after two cricketing legends, **Allan Border** of Australia and **Sunil Gavaskar** of India.
 
• It was first contested during the **1996/97 cricket season** when India hosted Australia for a one-off Test match.
 
• The Border-Gavaskar Trophy is a **bilateral Test series**, and its matches are part of the **ICC World Test Championship** since its inception in 2019.
 
• India has dominated the Border-Gavaskar Trophy in recent years, including memorable series wins in Australia in **2018-19** and **2020-21**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allan Border:**

 
 
• Allan Border is a former Australian cricketer who captained the Australian team for most of the 1980s.
 
• He is regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in cricket history and was the first player to reach **11,000 Test runs**.
 
 
 
• **Sunil Gavaskar:**
 
 
• Sunil Gavaskar is a former Indian cricketer and one of the finest opening batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• He was the first player to score **10,000 Test runs** and held the record for most centuries in Test cricket (34) for many years.
 
 
 
• **Significant Matches:**
 
 
• The 2001 Kolkata Test (Eden Gardens) is one of the most iconic matches in the Border-Gavaskar Trophy, where India achieved a historic victory after following on.
 
• The 2020-21 series marked a remarkable comeback by India after being bowled out for **36 in Adelaide**, culminating in a series win at the Gabba, Brisbane.
 
 
 
• **ICC World Test Championship:**
 
 
• The Border-Gavaskar Trophy is now a part of the ICC World Test Championship, adding more significance to the series.
 
• The ICC World Test Championship aims to crown the best Test cricket team globally through a league format.

questions.question: Which of the following teams won the Ranji trophy for the year 2019-20?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __Saurashtra__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Following a hard-fought final against Bengal at the Saurashtra Cricket Association Stadium in Rajkot, Saurashtra lifted the Ranji Trophy 2019-20 title.
 
• Though Bengal needed 72 runs and Saurashtra needed four wickets as the battle for the first-innings led to determine that the winner resumed on Day 5 For the first time in 70 years, Saurashtra team won the Ranji Trophy title.
 
• Based on the lead obtained in the first innings of the final against Bengal, Saurashtra became the champion. Saurashtra was formerly known as Navanagar, Western India, and won the 1936-37 and 1943-44 trophies.
 
• It was renamed in 1950 as Saurashtra and began to take part in this domestic tournament. 
 
• The Saurashtra team has been runners-up three times in the last seven years. It was the fourth Saurashtra final. On the basis of the first-innings lead against Bengal, Saurashtra achieved the distinction of being the champion.
 
• As the title was last captured in 1989-90, Bengal could not retain the title again.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's first-class domestic cricket competition is the Ranji Trophy. The country's provincial and state cricket associations are participating in this tournament.
 
• The competition is named after the first Indian player from India to compete in international cricket, Ranjit Singhji. In 1934, the first edition of the Ranji Trophy was organised.
 
• Mumbai has won the Ranji Trophy 41 times, while Vidarbha has won the title twice.

questions.question: Which of the following is the oldest tennis tournament in the world?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Wimbledon.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• Wimbledon__, is the oldest Grand Slam tennis tournament.
 
• It was started in 1877.
 
• This grass court tennis grand slam is the oldest of all four of these tennis events.
 
• The oldest, still-active tennis tournament in the entire world, it is looked at by many in the tennis world as the most prestigious, and it is usually held from late June to early July.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• There are four Grand Slam tournaments in Tennis viz. Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon and US Open. 
 
• These are the biggest tennis events of the year.
 
• US open
 
 
• It was started in 1881.
 
• It is held annually, starting on the last Monday in August, and lasting for two weeks into September, with the middle weekend coinciding with the Labor Day holiday.
 
• This tournament is played on a hard court.
 
 
 
• French Open
 
 
• It was started in 1891. 
 
• It is also known as the Roland Garros tournament.
 
• It was held over two weeks between late May and early June in Paris.
 
• This tournament is played on clay courts.
 
 
 
• Australian Open
 
 
• It was started in 1905. 
 
• This tournament is held annually in Melbourne over the fortnight of January.
 
• It is played on hard courts. 
 
• The tournament holds the record for the highest attendance at a Grand Slam event.
